# Alphabet

Alphabet is a public company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. The company trades under the ticker GOOGL and maintains an investor relations presence at abc.xyz.

The held facts indicate Alphabet has 220 cases associated with California law exposure. No MCP servers or tracked AI products are currently registered in the system, though the company's investor relations page serves as its primary web presence in this reference database.
